purpose: Prolonged browser input on the actual supplied user project, reproducing0.1.4 post-release geometry backlog and surface deterioration; paired final real-time host and geometry verification.
claim_scope: Synthetic isolated headlessChrome/WASM/WebGL2 and controlled no-window CGL visualization; no physical mouse/pen latency, nativeGUI, full platform matrix, general self-intersection guarantee or ZBrush parity.

user_fixture.scope: Original supplied files remain immutable; project is loaded through existing file-input change handler calling public WebHandle.load_document. Screenshots are not edited. Actual mesh is rendered separately.

method.initial_mesh: 61,580vertices /123,156triangles, exact supplied version1 project; fresh app then public file import for each independent brush scenario. Default camera automatically frames original mesh.
method.input: 20-second repeating figure-eight path per brush;500pointermoves plus initialmove/down/up =503events. First100moves at50ms spacing (20Hz), next250at20ms (50Hz), final150at66.667ms (15Hz). Node schedules independently of ACKs; exact scheduled and observed dispatch traces are retained.
method.capture: Continuous main-task/RAF, actual drawElements and mesh-buffer uploads. After realDOMmouseup, wait for>1200ms since upload and pointer with last callback<20ms, bounded60s. Before Save, read actual WebGL2 meshVBO bytes and SHA256; pack positions/normals/masks/colors from subsequent saved project to f32x10 and require equalhash. Save twice1500ms apart and require exact mesh equality; whole-stroke Undo/Redo also checked.
method.completion: The pre-save GPU/saved equality distinguishes visible completed geometry from a Save that secretly flushes queued changes. Observed quiet is not direct privatequeue inspection; final public counters add queue evidence.
method.tail_definition: Last recorded mesh buffer upload ending after the actual sculpt pointerup handling time. This records visible-geometry submission after release, not GPU presentation. Required1200ms quiet is reported separately.
method.quantiles: Sorted finite durations; pX uses index floor((n-1)*X).
method.frame_definition: Mesh drawElements TRIANGLES count>=200000 (all these123k+face user meshes); independent RAF pump is reported separately and cannot stand in for actual mesh submissions.
method.webgl_cpu_timing: bufferData, queries and draw submission timestamps are CPU API timing, not independent GPU timer queries or physical display latency. GPU digest readback occurs after input and observedquiet.
method.instrumentation: Relative to frozen baseline long.mjs: same WebGL/frame/pointer instrumentation and same independent schedules; final adds public sculpt counter sampling every200ms plus counter checkpoints, adding small unisolated overhead. No identical-harness-byte claim.
method.process_isolation: Only spawned headlessChrome processes with dedicated profiles and owned127.0.0.1 HTTP/CDP listeners. No desktop/accessibility/VoiceOver/user-browser/user-process control; only loopback page resources allowed.

data.diagnostic_scope: Numerical final mesh structure/face quality; no global self-intersection test or ZBrush parity. Imported defects are retained explicitly.

saved_mesh_quality.scope: Finite data, face-index validity, edge multiplicity/winding, geometric adjacent-face angles and normalized triangle quality2sqrt(3)*cross_length/sum_edge_length_squared. Closed topology does not imply no self-intersections; original imported sharp/sliver defects are counted explicitly. No predeclared global surface-quality acceptance threshold for this supplied sculpt.

offline_visuals.scope: Actual original/baseline/final saved meshes and separately labelled Loop-preview copy with exact source GLSL, matched fixed camera/color/resolution,4xMSAA; no image edit, no nativewindow. Offline CGL does not certify egui callback state or human perception.

preserved_failed_checks.classification: Public file-input setup did not trigger measured repaint before readiness timeout; no JS/GL error. Harmless own-page pointer repaint synchronization resolved readiness, and exact imported Save verified consumer geometry. This is preserved separately from successful stroke metrics.
Harness syntax error corrected before launching Chrome.

preserved_intermediate_builds.reason: e8c3… build frozen before shipping quality gate tightened; never runtime sampled or promoted as final.

offline_close_view_inspection: Tighter frontal original/Loop-preview pair yaw0,pitch0,distance1.6,target(0,0,1) retains thin forehead slits and right/lower rim corrugation in the preview. Broad forms soften at this view, but residual artifacts and worse minimum triangle quality preclude a fully-repaired claim.
limits: One20-second scenario per brush per build, one user model, oneAppleM2/Chrome155/ANGLEMetal/DPR1; no broad capacity or platform claim.

Input event coalescing and deliberate final overload coalescing mean shape equality with old FIFO is not expected. Actual coalesced/applied/processed counters are reported, not called lossless replay.
Final public oldest-pending-age samples are queued-input age, not physical input/display latency or an unconditional hard execution bound.
Imported sharp faces/slivers can remain outside edited regions; runtime/closed-topology checks do not establish global surface repair.
Camera framing is deterministic from original mesh; windowless CGL uses matched double-precision camera calculation and is not a pixel-identical browser presentation check.
No load/save persistence across browser restarts, tablet pressure, alternate browsers/GPU, million-vertex imported model or nativeGUI validation in this record.
